For each d=1,2,3, unique first-nonzero-coefficient normalization exhausts exactly (5^N-1)/4 classes with N=3,6,10, namely 31,3906,2441406. The complete C++17 program and a separate NumPy cubic enumeration were executed; there is no extrapolation from partial enumeration.

value.rationale: The theorem answers a named extremal question of Asgarli--Ghioca for the natural first odd prime field omitted by their general q>=11 construction. It supplies a smooth four-monomial witness even though their q-1 example fails for q=5 and establishes exact impossibility of all smaller degrees, including reducible and singular equations. Sharp finite-field existence/nonexistence is a natural mathematical boundary rather than an arbitrary table entry.
